description: The caller's own $ROKHA fuel tanks: deposit wallet, spendable balance (tokens + USD), owner-funded vs donated, burned and housed totals, what the owner may withdraw, burn tier, and whether the tank is dormant (below one turn's reserve). On an agent's own turn it shows only that agent's tank. Read-only; signed-in callers only.
